label: main season
summary: Recommend cancellation by non-technical survey for sign-off. Two separate first-hand sources report safe use for 24 and 12 years (E2, E5), meeting the two-source/five-year criterion. The only contamination report is an unlocated, unsubstantiated second-hand warning (E4), which is accounted for by the safe-use evidence. There is no direct or stronger indirect evidence, and no accident is recorded inside the area. The rule check passed.
flags: The nearest recorded past landmine accident is within 1 km, but the dossier does not place it inside COC-0112.
The survey team's own observation covered paths and field edges; the area is recorded as entirely forest.
The zone survey flag and priority identify where to survey, not evidence of contamination.

checks.detail: Every item of the evidence log is in the register.
There is no direct evidence and no indirect evidence of class 1 to 4, and every item of weaker indirect evidence is explained by evidence of absence of class 1 to 4.
2 different reliable source(s) report at least 5 years of safe use (E2; E5); the criteria need 2.
No past landmine accident is recorded inside the area.

E1.quote: We have walked the trail across this land to the school for 4 years. Nobody has found anything, and nobody has been hurt.
E1.note: First-hand user reports four years of safe use, supporting absence; this is under the five-year threshold for cancellation.

E2.quote: the board has recorded no find or accident in the area in the 24 years she has held the post, and that families use land in the area every week.
E2.note: First-hand community representative reports a long record without finds or accidents and regular local use, supporting absence and accounting for the vague rumor.

E3.quote: The survey team walked the paths and field edges of the area and saw no items, signs, fencing or other marks of contamination.
E3.note: The survey team's own observation found no indications along the paths and field edges; this supports absence but is limited to areas observed.

E4.quote: people should keep away from the area because of mines, but could not say who had seen anything, or where.
E4.note: This is an unsubstantiated second-hand warning with no identifiable first-hand source or location, so it is weak indirect evidence.

E5.quote: he has cut firewood and timber in the area every year for the past 12 years, and has never found anything or heard of an accident there.
E5.note: A first-hand land user reports 12 years of regular safe use, supporting absence and accounting for the vague rumor.
